govdocs-archive_org-TheInteriorCastleOrT: St. Teresa of Ávila’s Interior Castle — or The Mansions — is the great Carmelite’s guide to mystical prayer. The seven mansions map the soul’s journey to union with God. Her prose burns with love. The book is the summit of Christian mysticism.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-JournalofForens: Don Olson and Ralph F. Turner’s Photographic Evidence and the Assassination of President John F. Kennedy is a forensic science paper. The paper analyzed the photo record. The file belongs to the assassination archive. The item is a fragment of the scholarly record.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-RPTOfDoJTaskFor: This report of the DOJ Task Force on Domestic Security Investigations is a Justice Department file. The task force reviewed the surveillance programs. The report endures. The file belongs to the government archive. The item is a fragment of the record.
personal-narrative-of-travels-to-the-equ: Alexander von Humboldt's great record of travel goes on — the bold survey of South America that taught the world to see nature whole. This volume bears his party through Venezuela and up the Orinoco, keen-eyed as ever. The base book of modern earth science, and grand adventure too.
the-church-and-the-empire-being-an-outli: Dudley Medley outlines the church's history from 1003 — its tangled relations with empire and state. His clear survey serves students well. A useful short history of a vast subject. Popes, emperors, and reformers cross his well-ordered stage. Students have long prized his lucid, fair-minded summary.
